answer: Operator Liability Pool. Each identity registers against an operator-held deposit; if a cluster of identities shares behavior, the pool pays a penalty drawn from that operator's deposit, not the identities' balances. An attacker must fund a fresh deposit per operator and forfeit it on detection, so marginal sybil cost scales with operators, not wallets. Identity creation emits a pulse to the pool's audit ledger. Any operator with unpaid penalties enters a river of escalating deposit requirements. Flagged operators receive an ivory-tier suspension barring new registrations.
